answer: Rate-limited validator sampling: each epoch a public beacon picks 7 of every 100 identities for a live audit, and a failed audit slashes a 150 POA stake by 60%. A velvet-smooth farm of fakes cannot hide, because the audit odds hit every account, so an operator running 50 identities faces about 3.5 audits per epoch. Across the ocean of honest agents, the atlas of audit results is public, so anyone can recheck it.
